description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eldrazi Skyspawner, adding {C}{C}.
When Eldrazi Skyspawner dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Eldrazi Skyspawner from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Eldrazi Skyspawner enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
